items.text: Industrial biotechnology careers use microbes and enzymes to make chemicals, fuels, materials and ingredients at scale, and they depend on fermentation skill, process control, scale-up thinking and careful quality and safety practice.
Learn bioprocess basics, spend time in a fermentation lab or plant and document one small optimisation exercise.
Verify the track record of any employer or training provider and avoid guaranteed-job offers.
